title: Electromyography in Patients on Chronic Pyridostigmine Therapy
brief_summary: We intend to measure evoked EMG at two sites in subjects who are chronically taking pyridostigmine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who have been taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of any condition other than myasthenia gravis

Exclusion Criteria

* Subjects taking pyridostigmine for the treatment of myasthenia gravis will be excluded.
